title: AquaTerra's first drives, 2021 · AquaTerra
description: AquaTerra's first year of drives, June to December 2021: {count} drives and {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, from Ek Tara workshops to the first Sundarbans trips.
lede: AquaTerra started running drives in June 2021, a few months after the organisation was founded. That first year ran from June to December and came to {count} drives, {volunteers} volunteer turnouts and {placesCount} places, mostly workshops at Ek Tara, planting days and the first Sundarbans relief trips.

sections.heading: what the first drives were
body: The first drive was Life in a Bottle, a pot painting workshop at Ek Tara on June 19, 2021. The students painted thirty vases, then got their hands muddy planting saplings. July brought the first Sundarbans relief trip, Sunderbans 1.0 on July 3, and Grow Green Plantation Drive 1.0 at Ward 58 on July 16, where 100 saplings went into the ground.

After that the year settled into a rhythm of workshops and planting. Between August and December we ran more sessions at Ek Tara, a planting day called Roots in Mud, Genesis Sunderbans 1.0 in October, and a Green Christmas workshop on December 23. The drives were hands-on and a bit messy, and that tone carried on into the years that followed.

sections.heading: a base at ek tara
body: Ek Tara hosted most of the year's workshops. Each one had its own theme: pot painting to open the year, climate awareness in Let's Talk Climate on August 31, planting in Roots in Mud, and Green Christmas, where volunteers swapped plastic for plants, crafts and a little cheer.

The Green Christmas session taught thirty-five children, and the climate workshop was built around everyday action people could take at home. Each session was its own event rather than one large day. That steady run of small workshops is where the first year's children-focused work took shape.

sections.heading: the first sundarbans trips
body: The Sundarbans trips carried the year's relief work. The first, Sunderbans 1.0 on July 3, 2021, got food to 300 people and treated 200 patients. Sunderbans 2.0 followed on July 17 in Ward 142, where 130 saplings were planted and 100 patients were treated.

The autumn trip, Genesis Sunderbans 1.0 in October, was run together with Genesis (GECT). Volunteers travelled deep into the Sundarbans to hand out aid and talk with local residents. AquaTerra has run {sundarbansTrips} Sundarbans trips in all, and the first of them happened in this year.

sections.heading: what 2021 set up
body: Several patterns that later years repeat begin here. Grow Green and Sunderbans both used a numbered 1.0 in their names, so the numbered series AquaTerra went on to run were already in use by July. Green Christmas, the December workshop at Ek Tara, set the pattern for the seasonal sessions that came after it.

The voice of the drives was set early too: hands-on fun, muddy fingers, and volunteers who made real connections with the people they met. The next year, [2022](/impact/year-2022), shows how those series grew once the first year was behind them.

sections.heading: who showed up
body: Turnouts were modest. No drive in 2021 drew a large crowd, and most were run by a small team of four to ten students. The October Genesis trip had the biggest team at ten, and the Ward 58 plantation came next with eight.

Students did the hands-on work themselves: travelling to the Sundarbans, handing out food and aid, painting pots and planting saplings. AquaTerra's drives are student-run, and its members are aged 14 to 19.

learnings: The first year ran from June to December 2021, and it is the baseline that every later year is measured against.
Sundarbans relief started in the first summer, in July 2021, and the trips have continued in every year since.
Planting and workshops ran side by side from the start, at Ek Tara and at planting sites.
Numbered series such as Grow Green 1.0 and Sunderbans 1.0 began in 2021 and became a pattern later years followed.
Each drive's own figure belongs to that drive, so the first year is best read one drive at a time.

faqs.a: In 2021, its first year of drives, AquaTerra ran {count} drives from June to December, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts across {placesCount} places. They were pot painting and climate workshops at Ek Tara, planting days and the first Sundarbans relief trips, all run by student members.

faqs.q: When did AquaTerra start its drives?
faqs.a: AquaTerra was founded in June 2021, and its first drive was Life in a Bottle, a pot painting workshop at Ek Tara on June 19, 2021.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra go to the Sundarbans in 2021?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra's first Sundarbans trip was Sunderbans 1.0 on July 3, 2021, followed by Sunderbans 2.0 on July 17 and Genesis Sunderbans 1.0 in October, which was run together with Genesis (GECT). The trips brought food, aid and patient care to villages in the Sundarbans.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra plant trees in its first year?
faqs.a: Yes. Grow Green Plantation Drive 1.0 at Ward 58 on July 16, 2021 planted 100 saplings, and Roots in Mud at Ek Tara on August 27 planted 80. Grow Green went on to run in later years as well.

faqs.q: How do I join an AquaTerra drive?
faqs.a: Sign in with Google and wait for the approval step. AquaTerra's members are students aged 14 to 19, and the first-year drives show the kind of work they do: workshops, planting and Sundarbans aid.
